import OffFiveDiscSingleTable189

namespace OffFive16ConnectedTwin
open Finset
abbrev Marks := OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.Marks
abbrev Label := Fin 16
abbrev Codes := Fin 4 × Fin 4 × Fin 4 × Fin 4

def code (C : Codes) (u : ℕ) : Fin 4 :=
  if u=11 then 3 else if u=12 then C.1 else if u=13 then C.2.1
  else if u=14 then C.2.2.1 else if u=15 then C.2.2.2 else 0

def tailPairs : List (ℕ×ℕ) := [(12,13),(12,14),(12,15),(13,14),(13,15),(14,15)]
def tailBit (M : List Bool) (a b : ℕ) : Bool :=
  M[(tailPairs.idxOf (a,b))]?.getD false

def portL (c : Fin 4) : Prop := c=1 ∨ c=3
def portR (c : Fin 4) : Prop := c=2 ∨ c=3
instance (c : Fin 4) : Decidable (portL c) := by unfold portL; infer_instance
instance (c : Fin 4) : Decidable (portR c) := by unfold portR; infer_instance

def dir (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (u v : Label) : Bool :=
  let a := u.val
  let b := v.val
  ((if h : a<12 ∧ b<12 then
    OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.dir j m ⟨a,h.1⟩ ⟨b,h.2⟩ else false) ||
    decide ((a=1 ∧ 12≤b ∧ portL (code C b)) ∨ (a=j ∧ 12≤b ∧ portR (code C b)))) ||
    (decide (11≤a ∧ a<b) && (decide (code C a=3 ∨ code C b=3) || tailBit M a b))

def edge (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (u v : Label) : Bool :=
  dir j m C M u v || dir j m C M v u

def two (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (u : Label) : Finset Label :=
  univ.filter fun v => v≠u ∧ !edge j m C M u v=true ∧
    ∃ w : Label,edge j m C M u w=true ∧ edge j m C M w v=true

def witnesses (j : ℕ) (v : Label) : List Label :=
  if v.val=0 ∨ v.val=10 then List.finRange 16
  else if v.val≤10 then
    [Fin.ofNat' 16 (v.val-1),Fin.ofNat' 16 (v.val+1),0,10,11,12,13,14,15]
  else [1,Fin.ofNat' 16 j,11,12,13,14,15]

def fastTwo (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (u : Label) : Finset Label :=
  univ.filter fun v => v≠u ∧ !edge j m C M u v=true ∧
    (witnesses j v).any (fun w => edge j m C M u w && edge j m C M w v)=true

theorem fastTwo_sub (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (u : Label) :
    fastTwo j m C M u⊆two j m C M u := by
  intro v vm
  obtain ⟨_,ne,no,se⟩ := mem_filter.mp vm
  obtain ⟨w,_,wse⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp se
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at wse
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,ne,no,w,wse.1,wse.2⟩

def deg (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (u : Label) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun v => edge j m C M u v=true).card

def coreSites : List Label := [11,12,13,14,15]
def degreeCap (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ((univ : Finset Label).filter (fun v => 11≤v.val ∧ deg j m C M v<4)).card≤1

instance (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) :
    Decidable (degreeCap j m C M) := by unfold degreeCap; infer_instance

def codeSites : List ℕ := [11,12,13,14,15]
def leftCount (C : Codes) : ℕ := ((univ : Finset Label).filter (fun v => 11≤v.val ∧ portL (code C v.val))).card
def rightCount (C : Codes) : ℕ := ((univ : Finset Label).filter (fun v => 11≤v.val ∧ portR (code C v.val))).card

def goodCode (j : ℕ) (C : Codes) : Prop :=
  C.1≤C.2.1 ∧ C.2.1≤C.2.2.1 ∧ C.2.2.1≤C.2.2.2 ∧
    leftCount C≤2 ∧ (j=9 → rightCount C≤2)
instance (j : ℕ) (C : Codes) : Decidable (goodCode j C) := by unfold goodCode; infer_instance

def codeTuples (j : ℕ) : List Codes :=
 ((List.finRange 4).flatMap fun a => (List.finRange 4).flatMap fun b =>
  (List.finRange 4).flatMap fun c => (List.finRange 4).map fun d => (a,b,c,d)).filter
    (fun C => decide (goodCode j C))

theorem codeMem {j : ℕ} {C : Codes} (h : goodCode j C) : C∈codeTuples j := by
  rcases C with ⟨a,b,c,d⟩
  apply List.mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨?_,decide_eq_true h⟩
  exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨a,List.mem_finRange _,List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    ⟨b,List.mem_finRange _,List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    ⟨c,List.mem_finRange _,List.mem_map.mpr ⟨d,List.mem_finRange _,rfl⟩⟩⟩⟩

def bits : ℕ→List (List Bool)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n+1 => (bits n).flatMap (fun e => [false::e,true::e])

theorem mem_bits (M : List Bool) : M∈bits M.length := by
  induction M with
  | nil => simp [bits]
  | cons x L h =>
    apply List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    refine ⟨L,h,?_⟩
    cases x <;> simp

def canonical (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) : Bool :=
  tailPairs.all fun p => decide ((code C p.1=3 ∨ code C p.2=3) → tailBit M p.1 p.2=false)

def Chain (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (l : List Label) : Prop :=
  l.Nodup ∧ (∀ v : Label,v∈l) ∧ l.Chain' (fun v w => edge j m C M v w=true)
instance (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) (l : List Label) :
    Decidable (Chain j m C M l) := by unfold Chain; infer_instance

theorem pool_good :
    pool.all (fun p => decide (Chain p.j (OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList p.signs)
      p.C p.edges p.path))=true := by decide +kernel

def hasPath (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) : Bool :=
  pool.any fun p => decide (p.j=j ∧ p.signs=List.ofFn m ∧ p.C=C ∧ p.edges=M)

theorem hasPath_sound {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {C : Codes} {M : List Bool}
    (h : hasPath j m C M=true) : ∃ l : List Label,Chain j m C M l := by
  obtain ⟨p,pm,pe⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d⟩ := of_decide_eq_true pe
  have yes := of_decide_eq_true (List.all_eq_true.mp pool_good p pm)
  exact ⟨p.path,by simpa only [a,b,c,d,OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList_ofFn] using yes⟩

def caps (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool)
    (D : ℕ→Marks→Codes→List Bool→Label→Finset Label) : Prop :=
  (D j m C M 0).card≤4 ∧ (D j m C M 10).card≤4 ∧ (D j m C M 11).card≤4 ∧
  (D j m C M 12).card≤4 ∧ (D j m C M 13).card≤4 ∧ (D j m C M 14).card≤4 ∧ (D j m C M 15).card≤4

instance (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool)
    (D : ℕ→Marks→Codes→List Bool→Label→Finset Label) : Decidable (caps j m C M D) := by
  unfold caps
  infer_instance

def gate (j : ℕ) (m : Marks) (C : Codes) (M : List Bool) : Bool :=
  !(decide (canonical C M=true ∧ degreeCap j m C M ∧ caps j m C M fastTwo)) || hasPath j m C M

def row (j : ℕ) (signs : List (Fin 3)) : Bool :=
  let m := OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList signs
  (codeTuples j).all fun C =>
    if (fastTwo j m C [] 0).card≤4 ∧ (fastTwo j m C [] 10).card≤4 then
      (bits 6).all (gate j m C)
    else true

end OffFive16ConnectedTwin

import OffFiveConnectedTwinBase189

namespace OffFive16ConnectedTwin
open Finset

private theorem edge_nil_sub {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {C : Codes} (M : List Bool) (u v : Label) :
    edge j m C [] u v=true → edge j m C M u v=true := by
  have d (x y : Label) : dir j m C [] x y=true → dir j m C M x y=true := by
    intro h
    simp only [dir,tailBit,List.getElem?_nil,Option.getD_none,Bool.or_false,
      Bool.or_eq_true,Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    simp only [dir,Bool.or_eq_true,Bool.and_eq_true]
    exact h.elim Or.inl (fun h => .inr ⟨h.1,.inl h.2⟩)
  simp only [edge,Bool.or_eq_true]
  exact fun h => h.imp (d _ _) (d _ _)

private theorem edge_nil_at {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {C : Codes} (M : List Bool) (u v : Label)
    (ul : u.val≤10) : edge j m C [] u v=edge j m C M u v := by
  have a : ¬(11≤u.val ∧ u.val<v.val) := by omega
  have b : ¬(11≤v.val ∧ v.val<u.val) := by omega
  have e : decide (11≤u.val ∧ u.val<v.val)=false := decide_eq_false a
  have f : decide (11≤v.val ∧ v.val<u.val)=false := decide_eq_false b
  simp only [edge,dir,e,f,Bool.false_and,Bool.or_false]

theorem pre_sub {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {C : Codes} (M : List Bool) (u : Label)
    (ul : u.val≤10) : fastTwo j m C [] u⊆two j m C M u := by
  intro v vt
  obtain ⟨_,vn,no,ex⟩ := mem_filter.mp vt
  obtain ⟨w,_,wse⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp ex
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at wse
  have de := edge_nil_at (j:=j) (m:=m) (C:=C) M u v ul
  rw [de] at no
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,vn,no,w,edge_nil_sub M u w wse.1,edge_nil_sub M w v wse.2⟩

theorem allFast {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {C : Codes} {M : List Bool}
    (h : caps j m C M two) : caps j m C M fastTwo := by
  have q (v : Label) := card_le_card (fastTwo_sub j m C M v)
  exact ⟨(q 0).trans h.1,(q 10).trans h.2.1,(q 11).trans h.2.2.1,
    (q 12).trans h.2.2.2.1,(q 13).trans h.2.2.2.2.1,
    (q 14).trans h.2.2.2.2.2.1,(q 15).trans h.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩

theorem span_from_row {j : ℕ} {m : Marks} {C : Codes} {M : List Bool}
    (ok : row j (List.ofFn m)=true) (gc : goodCode j C) (ml : M.length=6)
    (cm : canonical C M=true) (degree : degreeCap j m C M) (dc : caps j m C M two) :
    ∃ l : List Label,Chain j m C M l := by
  have h := List.all_eq_true.mp ok C (codeMem gc)
  change (if (fastTwo j (OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList (List.ofFn m)) C [] 0).card≤4 ∧
      (fastTwo j (OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList (List.ofFn m)) C [] 10).card≤4
    then (bits 6).all (gate j (OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList (List.ofFn m)) C) else true)=true at h
  rw [OffFive16DisconnectedSingle.fromList_ofFn] at h
  have pre0 := (card_le_card (pre_sub (j:=j) (m:=m) (C:=C) M 0 (by decide))).trans dc.1
  have pre10 := (card_le_card (pre_sub (j:=j) (m:=m) (C:=C) M 10 (by decide))).trans dc.2.1
  rw [if_pos ⟨pre0,pre10⟩] at h
  have mem : M∈bits 6 := by rw [←ml]; exact mem_bits M
  have yes := List.all_eq_true.mp h M mem
  exact hasPath_sound (by simpa [gate,cm,degree,allFast dc] using yes)

#print axioms span_from_row
end OffFive16ConnectedTwin
